idea.description: The idea in the user's words.

target_customer.description: Who has the problem, from the user's context.

market_country.description: Country whose market, sources, and currency the check should use.
market_country.x-ask: Which country should this check cover?

document_language.description: Language for the prose. Headings stay as written in template.md.
document_language.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

research_mode.description: web when the cited pages were opened during this run. offline when they were not.
research_mode.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

customer_tests.description: Interviews, landing pages, signups, or payments the user already has. One row that says none yet when they have not tested.
customer_tests.x-ask: What have customers already done? Name interviews, signups, or payments. Say none yet.

problem.description: The problem in one or two sentences.
problem.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

who_affected.description: Who feels the problem, in one or two sentences.
who_affected.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

workaround.description: What people do today instead, including email, spreadsheets, or nothing.
workaround.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

pain_type.description: painkiller when people already act to stop the pain. vitamin when the current way already works. unclear otherwise.
pain_type.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

solution_fit.description: What would have to be true for the customer to switch. One or two sentences.
solution_fit.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

market.description: TAM, SAM, and SOM, in that order. SOM is not a percent of TAM.
market.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

competitors.description: Real competitors whose websites were opened. One strength and one weakness each.
competitors.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

community.description: Public pages that were opened. One row that says none were opened is allowed.
community.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.

checks.description: Pain, Market, Alternatives, Customer pull, in that order.
checks.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

decision.description: go only when Pain, Alternatives, and Customer pull pass. no when the same offer is already sold or the idea is a vitamin with no pull. not yet otherwise.
decision.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

decision_reason.description: Two sentences naming the checks that did not pass.
decision_reason.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

next_test.description: The single next customer test. Not a build plan while Customer pull is gap or fail.
next_test.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

assumptions.description: Every estimate, with the inputs it uses.
assumptions.x-unknown: Derive this field from the context and sources. Do not leave it blank.

sources.description: Pages opened for this check. Empty only when research_mode is offline.
sources.x-unknown: Research this field and cite a source. Do not leave it blank.
